children: rose about 7% on Thursday, snapping a four-session losing streak, after Piper Sandler said the social-media platform’s average users grew 8% month over month in August, the strongest monthly increase this year.
Piper said the increase followed a 2% decline in July, with gains in Reddit’s

Feed audience more than offsetting a decline in Conversation users. Total audience growth accelerated to 18% year over year in August from 12.8% in July, according to the brokerage’s analysis of Reddit
was also slightly higher on Thursday after closing about 6.5% higher in the previous session, although its gains were driven by investor enthusiasm over its
agent. Other ad-supported social media peers, including Snap
, which had declined over the previous few sessions, also edged higher on Thursday.

International users grew 29.3% in August, accelerating from 19% in July, while U.S. users increased 5.2%, Piper said. The brokerage also noted that weekly user momentum has been strong since early July, driven largely by the International Feed.
Piper cautioned that changes to Reddit’s

Ads Manager forecasting model are expected to reduce September audience-size estimates by about 20%. The brokerage said the one-time reset reflects changes to the methodology and does not indicate a deterioration in underlying user trends. The changes affect forecasting rather than auctions, optimization, or ad delivery.
The brokerage also said August ad spending across its digital advertising dataset was 60 basis points above expectations, with the biggest beats coming from Netflix
, and PINS. However, its estimate for third-quarter spending growth rose 30 basis points. Reddit’s
own third-quarter ad-spending growth estimate was raised 30 basis points.

title: Reddit gains as August user growth accelerates, Piper says
